  +def fr_progress(rows, *, final=False):
  +    """Order and early stop of FR (S2B_PLAN.md §2; S2B-2), a pure function. rows: one per FR cell in FR_ORDER,
  +    {"label", "status" (A2 record status or None), "end_rule" (outcome or None), "check" (the a2v job state or None),
  +    "valid" (validity_final.valid or None)}. The first cell that has not ended is the next one to run (final: a
  +    refusal); the first cell that ended without acceptance, without a final-geometry check or with a failed check ends
  +    FR. Returns {first_failure: None | {cell, kind, end_rule}, next, cells_not_run, passed}."""
  +    labs = [(r or {}).get("label") for r in rows]
  +    if labs != list(FR_ORDER):
  +        raise GateRefused(f"FR rows {labs} are not the FR cells in their order {list(FR_ORDER)} (S2B §2)")
  +    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
  +        lab, st = r["label"], r.get("status")
  +        kind = None
  +        if st is None or st == "pending":
  +            if final:
  +                raise GateRefused(f"FR: {lab} has not ended (status {st}); gate FR is evaluated at the end (S2B §2)")
  +            return {"first_failure": None, "next": lab, "cells_not_run": [], "passed": None}
  +        if st != "complete":
  +            kind = st
  +        elif r.get("end_rule") not in RULES["END_ACCEPTED"]:
  +            kind = "end_rule"
  +        elif r.get("valid") is None:
  +            if not final and r.get("check") in (None, "pending"):
  +                return {"first_failure": None, "next": None, "cells_not_run": [], "passed": None}   # the check waits
  +            kind = "check_not_evaluated"
  +        elif r.get("valid") is not True:
  +            kind = "check"
  +        if kind is not None:
  +            if kind not in FR_KINDS:
  +                raise GateRefused(f"FR: {lab} has the unknown A2 status {st!r}")
  +            return {"first_failure": {"cell": lab, "kind": kind, "end_rule": r.get("end_rule")}, "next": None,
  +                    "cells_not_run": list(FR_ORDER[i + 1:]), "passed": False}
  +    return {"first_failure": None, "next": None, "cells_not_run": [], "passed": True}
  +

  +def fr_eval(t):
  +    """FR-1 (S2B_PLAN.md §2; S2B-X3, X4). t: {label: {"status", "end_rule" (outcome), "validity_final" (the record's
  +    leaves or None), "a1_valid"}} for the FR cells. A validity_final of another check-5 reading is a refusal. Returns
  +    {cells, first_failure, end_rule_failed, checks_failed (K3-style reasons), cells_not_run, invariant_only (labels),
  +    a1_invalid_reported, FR1}; the A1 validity of the start cells is reported only (I-11)."""
  +    rows, inv_only = [], []
  +    for lab in FR_ORDER:
  +        c = t.get(lab) or {}
  +        vf = c.get("validity_final")
  +        if vf is not None and vf.get("check5_reading") != "invariant":
  +            raise GateRefused(f"FR: {lab} has a final-geometry check without the invariant reading of check 5 "
  +                              f"(check5_reading {vf.get('check5_reading')!r}; S2B §2, X4)")
  +        rows.append({"label": lab, "status": c.get("status"), "end_rule": c.get("end_rule"),
  +                     "check": "done" if vf is not None else None,
  +                     "valid": None if vf is None else vf.get("valid") is True})
  +        if vf is not None and vf.get("invariant_only") is True:
  +            inv_only.append(lab)
  +    pr = fr_progress(rows, final=True)
  +    ff, end_bad, checks_bad = pr["first_failure"], [], []
  +    if ff is not None:
  +        c = t.get(ff["cell"]) or {}
  +        if ff["kind"] == "check":
  +            checks_bad.append(f"{ff['cell']}: final geometry fails check(s) {(c.get('validity_final') or {}).get('failed')}")
  +        elif ff["kind"] == "check_not_evaluated":
  +            end_bad.append(f"{ff['cell']}: no final-geometry check")
  +        else:
  +            end_bad.append(f"{ff['cell']}: end rule {c.get('end_rule')} (status {c.get('status')})")
  +    return {"cells": t, "first_failure": ff, "end_rule_failed": end_bad, "checks_failed": checks_bad,
  +            "cells_not_run": pr["cells_not_run"], "invariant_only": inv_only,
  +            "a1_invalid_reported": [lab for lab in FR_ORDER if (t.get(lab) or {}).get("a1_valid") is not True],
  +            "FR1": pr["passed"] is True}

  +# ---------------------------------------------------------------- c3b: valid hosts and the A1 tier (C3B-3)
  +def c3b_sites_check(sites, state):
  +    """C3B-3: the site table scripts/50 passes, {host: {L: {"first": [...], "far": [...]}}}, names exactly the eight
  +    production hosts of the state, each with 2 / 3 / 8 first-shell sites (B / A / X) and two far sites per
  +    sublattice, no site twice; else refused."""
  +    prod = ((state or {}).get("stage0") or {}).get("production_n8")
  +    if not isinstance(sites, dict) or not sites:
  +        raise GateRefused("c3b_tier: no site table (inputs c1.c3b_sites)")
  +    why = []
  +    if not prod or len(prod) != RULES["N_BASE"]:
  +        why.append("the state holds no Stage-0 production list of 8 hosts")
  +    elif sorted(sites) != sorted(prod):
  +        why.append(f"its hosts {sorted(sites)} are not the production list {sorted(prod)}")
  +    for h in sorted(sites):
  +        for L in "BAX":
  +            row = (sites[h] or {}).get(L) or {}
  +            first, far = list(row.get("first") or []), list(row.get("far") or [])
  +            if len(first) != RULES["FIRST_SHELL_SIZE"][L] or len(far) != C3B_FAR_SITES \
  +                    or len(set(first + far)) != len(first) + len(far):
  +                why.append(f"{h} {L}: {len(first)} first-shell and {len(far)} far sites")
  +    if why:
  +        raise GateRefused(f"c3b_tier: the site table is not that of S2B §3: {'; '.join(why)}")

  +def c3b_quartets(sites):
  +    """C3B-3: the production quartets of the site table, 24 per host (Sr at 4 B sites, Cs and GA at 5 A sites, Cl at
  +    10 X sites), each with the labels and work ids of its four cells (default pose)."""
  +    rows = []
  +    for h in sorted(sites):
  +        for L in "BAX":
  +            for role in ("first", "far"):

  +                        if d in C3B_DOPANTS:
  +                            rows.append({"h": h, "L": L, "j": int(j), "role": role, "d": d,
  +                                         "labels": {"host": lab_host(h), "V": lab_v(h, L, int(j)),
  +                                                    "D": lab_dop(h, d, int(j), "novac"),
  +                                                    "DV": lab_dop(h, d, int(j), "vac")},
  +                                         "wids": {"host": wid_host(h), "V": wid_v(h, L, int(j)),

  +                                                  "DV": wid_dop(h, d, int(j), "vac")}})

  +def c3b_table_labels(sites):
  +    """C3B-3: the single-point labels of every cell of every production quartet of the site table, sorted (544 for
  +    the table of S2B §3). scripts/50 compares them with the 'sp' labels of its graph before the first job."""
  +    return sorted({lab for q in c3b_quartets(sites) for lab in q["labels"].values()})

  +def c3b_tier_eval(hosts, quartets):
  +    """C3B-3, a pure function of validity flags. quartets: rows with h, d, role ('first' | 'far') and valid. A host
  +    is valid for d iff both far quartets of d are valid and at least VALID_HOST_MIN of its first-shell quartets on
  +    d's sublattice are (P:680-682); n_d counts them; computable iff n_d >= 2 for a decisive dopant."""
  +    n_d, valid_hosts = {}, {}
  +    for d in C3B_DOPANTS:
  +        L, ok = SUBLATTICE[d], []
  +        for h in sorted(hosts):
  +            far = [bool(q["valid"]) for q in quartets if q["h"] == h and q["d"] == d and q["role"] == "far"]
  +            first = [bool(q["valid"]) for q in quartets if q["h"] == h and q["d"] == d and q["role"] == "first"]
  +            if len(far) != C3B_FAR_SITES or len(first) != RULES["FIRST_SHELL_SIZE"][L]:
  +                raise GateRefused(f"c3b_tier: {h} {d} has {len(first)} first-shell and {len(far)} far quartets")
  +            if all(far) and sum(first) >= RULES["VALID_HOST_MIN"][L]:
  +                ok.append(h)
  +        valid_hosts[d], n_d[d] = ok, len(ok)
  +    return {"n_d": n_d, "valid_hosts": valid_hosts,
  +            "computable": any(n_d[d] >= C3B_TIER_MIN_HOSTS for d in C3B_DECISIVE)}
  +

  +def c3b_tier(reader, sites, state):
  +    """C3B-3: gate c3b_tier. Reads, for every cell of every production quartet, its single point in status mode and
  +    its record through the blinded loader (validity leaves only); no energy."""
  +    c3b_sites_check(sites, state)
  +    cells = {}
  +
  +    def cell(role, label, wid):
  +        if wid not in cells:
  +            st = reader.sp_state(label).get("status")
  +            rec = reader.record(wid)
  +            v = (rec or {}).get("validity") or {}
  +            if rec is not None and role != "host" and v.get("check5_reading") != "invariant":
  +                raise GateRefused(f"c3b_tier: the record of {wid} does not hold the invariant reading of check 5 "
  +                                  f"(check5_reading {v.get('check5_reading')!r}; S2B §3, X4)")
  +            why = ([] if st == "complete" else [f"single point {st}"]) + \
  +                  (["no record"] if rec is None else [] if v.get("valid") is True
  +                   else [f"invalid (checks {v.get('failed')})"])
  +            cells[wid] = {"role": role, "why": why, "invariant_only": v.get("invariant_only") is True}
  +        return cells[wid]
  +
  +    rows, bad = [], []
  +    for q in c3b_quartets(sites):
  +        why = {r: cell(r, q["labels"][r], q["wids"][r])["why"] for r in ("host", "V", "D", "DV")}
  +        valid = not any(why.values())
  +        rows.append({"h": q["h"], "d": q["d"], "role": q["role"], "valid": valid})
  +        if not valid:
  +            bad.append({"h": q["h"], "d": q["d"], "L": q["L"], "j": q["j"], "role": q["role"],
  +                        "cells": {q["wids"][r]: w for r, w in why.items() if w}})
  +    res = c3b_tier_eval(sorted(sites), rows)
  +    inv = sorted(w for w, c in cells.items() if c["invariant_only"])
  +    res.update({"n_quartets": len(rows), "n_valid_quartets": sum(r["valid"] for r in rows), "invalid_quartets": bad,
  +                "invariant_only": inv,
  +                "invariant_only_counts": {k: sum(1 for w in inv if cells[w]["role"] == k) for k in ("V", "D", "DV")}})
  +    return res

  +        n_ok, n_ref = 0, 0

  +        # verify --campaign fr: every file reproduces; a changed output gives 1 differing. IX-8: the output becomes the

  +        def verify_out(want_rc, want):
  +            so, se = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()

  +        verify_out(0, ok_lines)
  +        saved_v = g_["evaluate_gate"]
  +
  +        def eval_print(gate, *a_, **k_):                # the negative control: a print reached through verify
  +            rec_ = saved_v(gate, *a_, **k_)
  +            if gate == "FR":
  +                print({k: rec_["result"].get(k) for k in ("FR2",)})
  +            return rec_
  +        try:
  +            g_["evaluate_gate"] = eval_print
  +            try:
  +                verify_out(0, ok_lines)
  +                raise RuntimeError("verify --campaign fr: a print of the FR result was not caught")
  +            except AssertionError:
  +                pass
  +        finally:
  +            g_["evaluate_gate"] = saved_v

  +        out.append("verify --campaign fr with sentinel F: exactly 'OK   fr FR', 'OK   fr fr_step0', 'verify fr: 2 gate "
  +                   "files, 0 differ' on stdout and stderr; a changed final output: exactly 'DIFF fr FR', 'OK   fr "
  +                   "fr_step0', '... 1 differ'; no withheld name or sentinel printed; a print of the FR result through "
  +                   "verify caught (IX-8)")

  +        otherwise a STOP naming the file, before any state change (nothing is recorded or renamed). The exceptions are
  +        the leftovers of an applied route: a STEP0_FIX (fr_fix_leftover), which check_commit_s2b renames, and a
  +        STEP0_NO_ERROR (fr_noerror_leftover), which preconditions renames. When the state shows a route applied, the
  +        STOP says so (the file is then not that route's leftover)."""
  +        s0 = s.get("fr_step0") or {}
  +        outc = s0.get("outcome")
  +        have = [f"{self.c}/{n}" for n in ("STEP0_FIX", "STEP0_NO_ERROR") if os.path.exists(os.path.join(self.cdir, n))]
  +        if have == [f"{self.c}/STEP0_FIX"] and self.fr_fix_leftover(s):
  +            return
  +        if have == [f"{self.c}/STEP0_NO_ERROR"] and self.fr_noerror_leftover(s):
  +            return
  +        if have and outc != "fail_pending_fix":
  +            done = [f"{self.c}/{n}" for n, k in (("STEP0_FIX", "repeat"), ("STEP0_NO_ERROR", "no_error_found"))
  +                    if s0.get(k)]
  +            raise Stop(f"{' and '.join(have)} refused: the FR step-0 check is {outc}, not fail_pending_fix (N-FR6); " +
  +                       (f"the state records {' and '.join(done)} as applied earlier and this file is not the leftover "
  +                        f"of an applied route; this start changed nothing" if done else "nothing was recorded"))
  +        if len(have) == 2:
  +            raise Stop(f"{' and '.join(have)} are both present at fr_step0 fail_pending_fix: one route only (N-FR6); "
  +                       f"nothing was recorded")
  +
  +    def fr_fix_leftover(self, s):
  +        """N-FR6: fr/STEP0_FIX is the leftover of the applied route (its one save_state done, the rename not): fr_step0
  +        is repeat_pending with the file's note, the file names the recorded fr campaign commit, and the last
  +        commit_history entry came to that commit by fr/STEP0_FIX with that note."""
  +        try:
  +            tok = open(os.path.join(self.cdir, "STEP0_FIX")).read().split()
  +        except OSError:
  +            return False
  +        cc = (s.get("campaign_commit") or {}).get(self.c)
  +        h = (list(s.get("commit_history") or []) or [{}])[-1]
  +        s0 = s.get("fr_step0") or {}
  +        return (cc is not None and tok[:1] == [cc] and s0.get("outcome") == "repeat_pending" and
  +                h.get("via") == f"{self.c}/STEP0_FIX" and h.get("to") == cc and
  +                " ".join(tok[1:]) == h.get("note") == s0.get("fix_note"))
  +
  +    def fr_noerror_leftover(self, s):
  +        """N-FR6: fr/STEP0_NO_ERROR is the leftover of the applied route (its save_state done, the rename not): fr_step0
  +        is fail_final with no_error_found and the note of the file's text (.strip()[:300]), and fr/STEP0_FIX is
  +        absent."""
  +        try:
  +            text = open(os.path.join(self.cdir, "STEP0_NO_ERROR")).read()
  +        except OSError:
  +            return False
  +        s0 = s.get("fr_step0") or {}
  +        return (s0.get("outcome") == "fail_final" and s0.get("no_error_found") is True and
  +                s0.get("note") == text.strip()[:300] and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(self.cdir, "STEP0_FIX")))
  +
  +    def rename_used(self, p):
  +        """N-FR2, N-FR6: an fr route file (CAMPAIGN_COMMIT, STEP0_FIX, STEP0_NO_ERROR) goes to the first free name of
  +        <p>.used.<t>, <p>.used.<t>.1, <p>.used.<t>.2, ... (<t> the clock's second): a copy renamed earlier in the same
  +        second is never overwritten. Returns the new path."""
  +        base = p + f".used.{int(time.time())}"
  +        q, i = base, 0
  +        while os.path.lexists(q):
  +            i += 1
  +            q = f"{base}.{i}"
  +        os.replace(p, q)
  +        return q

  +    def s2b_route(self, name, head, ancestor):
  +        """N-FR2: the checks of a dated route file <c>/<name>; returns its note ('<date> <path>'), or STOPs naming
  +        every reason (nothing is recorded)."""
  +        p = os.path.join(self.cdir, name)
  +        if not os.path.exists(p):
  +            raise Stop(f"no {self.c}/{name}: the S2b campaign commit {head[:12]} is admitted only by a dated route "
  +                       f"file '<commit> <YYYY-MM-DD> <note path>' (X13, N-FR2)")
  +        line = open(p).read()
  +        tok, why = line.split(), []
  +        if len(tok) != 3:
  +            why.append(f"{len(tok)} tokens, not '<40-hex commit> <YYYY-MM-DD> <note path>'")
  +        else:
  +            h, day, note = tok
  +            if h != head:
  +                why.append(f"its commit {h[:12]} is not the checkout HEAD {head[:12]}")
  +            if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", day):
  +                why.append(f"the date {day!r} is not YYYY-MM-DD")
  +            if os.path.isabs(note) or ".." in note or not note.startswith("results/objective2/s2/"):
  +                why.append(f"the note path {note!r} is not a relative path under results/objective2/s2/")
  +            elif not self.be.git_tracked(note):
  +                why.append(f"the note {note} is not tracked at HEAD")
  +            elif ancestor is None or note not in self.be.git_changed_paths(ancestor, head):
  +                why.append(f"the note {note} is not changed between {str(ancestor)[:12]} and HEAD {head[:12]} (a dated "
  +                           f"note of this route)")
  +            else:
  +                try:
  +                    text = open(os.path.join(self.node.checkout, note)).read()
  +                except OSError as e:
  +                    text = None
  +                    why.append(f"the note {note} cannot be read ({type(e).__name__})")
  +                if text is not None and day not in text:
  +                    why.append(f"the note {note} does not contain its date {day}")
  +        if ancestor is None or not self.be.git_is_ancestor(ancestor, head):
  +            why.append(f"the commit {str(ancestor)[:12]} is not an ancestor of HEAD {head[:12]}")
  +        if name == "STEP0_FIX" and head == ancestor:
  +            why.append(f"HEAD {head[:12]} is the recorded {self.c} campaign commit: the fix is a new commit, a strict "
  +                       f"descendant of it")
  +        if self.c == "c3b":                                                 # N-C3B3 (amendment 2026-11-16a R-7, R-8)
  +            if ancestor is None:
  +                why.append("the state records no fr campaign commit (campaign_commit.fr)")
  +            elif head == ancestor:
  +                why.append(f"HEAD {head[:12]} is the recorded fr campaign commit: the c3b commit is a new commit, a "
  +                           f"strict descendant of it")
  +            if len(tok) == 3 and tok[2] != C3B_NOTE:
  +                why.append(f"the note of the c3b route is {C3B_NOTE}, not {tok[2]!r}")
  +            if not self.be.git_tracked(C3B_BLOCK4):
  +                why.append(f"{C3B_BLOCK4} is not tracked at HEAD")
  +            else:
  +                try:
  +                    b4 = open(os.path.join(self.node.checkout, C3B_BLOCK4)).read()
  +                except OSError as e:
  +                    b4 = None
  +                    why.append(f"{C3B_BLOCK4} cannot be read ({type(e).__name__})")
  +                if b4 is not None and c3b_block4_reason(b4):
  +                    why.append(f"{c3b_block4_reason(b4)}: block 4 is implemented at the c3b campaign commit (S2B "
  +                               f"amendment 2026-11-12a item 8)")
  +            if len(tok) == 3 and tok[2] == C3B_NOTE and self.be.git_tracked(C3B_NOTE):
  +                # review finding 9: the committed note is final (no date token, no open item, no draft mark)
  +                try:
  +                    held = [w for w in C3B_NOTE_FORBIDDEN
  +                            if w in open(os.path.join(self.node.checkout, C3B_NOTE)).read()]
  +                except OSError:
  +                    held = []                                               # unreadable: named above
  +                if held:
  +                    why.append(f"the note {C3B_NOTE} still holds {', '.join(repr(w) for w in held)}: it is committed "
  +                               f"final, with no date token, no open item and no draft mark")
  +        if self.state.get("commit") is None or not self.be.git_unchanged(self.state["commit"], head, S2B_NODE_SCRIPTS):
  +            why.append("qe_queue.sh, chain.sh or s2_run_qe.sh differ from the recorded S2 commit")
  +        if (self.state.get("campaigns") or {}).get("c2") != "done":
  +            why.append("C2 is not done")
  +        if c46.hygiene_violations(line):
  +            why.append("the line fails the hygiene check of scripts/46 (D-C2-4)")
  +        if why:
  +            raise Stop(f"{self.c}/{name} refused: {'; '.join(why)} (X13, N-FR2); nothing was recorded")
  +        return " ".join(tok[1:])

  +    def s2b_accept(self, name, head, ancestor, note, **keys):
  +        """N-FR2: one save_state records the commit, its history entry and any further S2b keys (the repeat state of
  +        STEP0_FIX); only then is the route file renamed (a leftover is renamed at the next start)."""
  +        self.state.setdefault("campaign_commit", {})[self.c] = head

  +                                                             "via": f"{self.c}/{name}", "campaign": self.c})
  +        self.state.update(keys)
  +        self.save_state()
  +        self.rename_used(os.path.join(self.cdir, name))

  +    def fr_step0_repeat(self, head, cc, note):
  +        """N-FR2, N-FR6 (S2B section 2: 'the repeat reruns only the cell whose check failed, from k = 0, and its
  +        attempt-1 files are set aside unread'): the failed cell's a2/<label>, gates/fr_step0.json and that gate's marker
  +        trio go to discarded/step0_attempt1_<t>/{a2,gates,gates_applied}/ (archived) and the check records aside
  +        (discard_checks); both moves skip what is absent, so a start cut short before the save repeats them. Then one
  +        save_state records the commit, its history entry and fr_step0 repeat_pending with the note, and STEP0_FIX is
  +        renamed (s2b_accept). No key is popped and the other cells stay as they are (step0_repeat is never called for
  +        fr). The log names the directory this start moved files to, or says that nothing was left to move (an earlier
  +        start cut short before its save moved them); a directory not made is never named."""
  +        s0 = dict(self.state.get("fr_step0") or {})
  +        cell = s0.get("cell")
  +        gid = {at: g for g, at in FR_STEP0_AT.items()}.get(cell)
  +        if gid is None:
  +            raise Stop(f"the FR step-0 state names no step-0 cell ({cell!r}): the repeat cannot be prepared (N-FR6)")
  +        dst = os.path.join(self.cdir, "discarded", f"step0_attempt1_{int(time.time())}")
  +        mk = self.gate_marker({"id": gid})[:-5]
  +        moves = [(os.path.join(self.cdir, "a2", cell), os.path.join(dst, "a2", cell)),
  +                 (self.L.gate(self.c, "fr_step0"), os.path.join(dst, "gates", "fr_step0.json"))]

  +                shutil.move(a, b)
  +                moved += 1
  +        self.discard_checks(self.c)

  +                        fr_step0={**s0, "outcome": "repeat_pending", "repeat": True, "fix_note": note,
  +                                  "attempt1": {k: s0.get(k) for k in ("attempts", "outcome", "cell")}})
  +        self.log(f"commit for the FR step-0 repeat accepted (N-FR2, N-FR6): {head[:12]}")
  +        earlier = "moved aside by an earlier start cut short before its save, or absent"
  +        where = (f"{moved} of its {len(moves)} attempt-1 paths moved to {os.path.relpath(dst, self.cdir)}" +
  +                 ("" if moved == len(moves) else f" (the others {earlier})") if moved else
  +                 f"none of its {len(moves)} attempt-1 paths left to move ({earlier})")
  +        self.log(f"FR step-0 repeat prepared: {cell}: {where}; {cell} reruns from k = 0 (attempt 2)")

  +    def s2b_refusal(self):
  +        """N-FR3: the reason a c1-c4 start is refused once C2 is done and HEAD is not the recorded S2 commit (or git
  +        fails), or None. On the node (not the mock) a missing or unreadable state.json is a refusal too: at the S2b
  +        code a c1-c4 start needs a checkout at the S2 commit, and only a readable state names it (the c1 mock campaign,
  +        the one start without a state, runs on the MockBackend). Reads only state.json and git; writes nothing."""
  +        if self.c in S2B_CAMPAIGNS:
  +            return None
  +        try:
  +            s = read_json(self.node.state)
  +        except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
  +            if self.be.mock:
  +                return None                                                 # load_state decides (a STOP)
  +            return (f"state.json cannot be read ({type(e).__name__}): a {self.c} start needs a checkout at the S2 "
  +                    f"commit, which only a readable state names (N-FR3, X13)")
  +        if not self.be.mock and not isinstance(s, dict):
  +            return (f"{'no state.json' if s is None else 'state.json is not a JSON object'}: a {self.c} start needs a "
  +                    f"checkout at the S2 commit, which only a readable state names (N-FR3, X13)")
  +        s = s or {}
  +        if (s.get("campaigns") or {}).get("c2") != "done":
  +            return None
  +        try:
  +            head = self.be.git_state()["head"]
  +        except Stop as e:
  +            return f"git failed in the checkout ({e})"
  +        if head != s.get("commit"):
  +            return (f"checkout HEAD {head[:12]} is not the recorded S2 commit {str(s.get('commit'))[:12]}: a {self.c} "
  +                    f"start needs a checkout at that commit (N-FR3, X13)")
  +        return None

  +            why.append(f"FR is {fr.get('outcome')!r} (part {fr.get('part')!r}), not a pass")
  +        if s.get("fr_stop"):
  +            why.append("an FR early stop (fr_stop) is recorded")
  +        s0 = s.get("fr_step0") if isinstance(s.get("fr_step0"), dict) else {}
  +        if s0.get("outcome") != "pass":
  +            why.append(f"the FR step-0 check is {s0.get('outcome')!r}, not 'pass'")

  +            cj = None
  +        if not isinstance(cj, dict) or cj.get("status") != "done" or cj.get("fr_outcome") != FR_OUTCOMES[0]:
  +            why.append("fr/campaign.json does not record status 'done' with fr_outcome 'pass'")
  +        return f"{'; '.join(why)}: {tail}" if why else None

  +def _below(rp, rd):
  +    """Where the real path rp lies with respect to the tree rd, by the three tests of s2b/fr_inputs.py _under (F9):
  +    None if it is not rd and does not lie under it, '' if it is rd, else its first component below rd. As strings,
  +    also casefolded (on a case-insensitive volume realpath keeps the typed case: '.../s2/C3' is '.../s2/c3'), and by
  +    identity, rp or one of its existing ancestors being the existing tree rd (os.path.samefile; a volume that folds
  +    case or Unicode normalisation)."""
  +    parts, n = rp.split(os.sep), len(rd.rstrip(os.sep).split(os.sep))
  +    for a, b in ((rp, rd), (rp.casefold(), rd.casefold())):
  +        if a == b or a.startswith(b.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep):
  +            return os.sep.join(parts[n:n + 1])
  +    if not os.path.exists(rd):
  +        return None
  +    x = rp
  +    while True:
  +        if os.path.exists(x) and os.path.samefile(x, rd):
  +            return os.sep.join(parts[len(x.split(os.sep)):][:1])
  +        up = os.path.dirname(x)
  +        if up == x:
  +            return None
  +        x = up

  +def write_manifest(out):
  +    """N-C3B7 (amendment 2026-11-16a, interface): MANIFEST.sha256 of an archive directory, written last: one line
  +    '<sha256>  <relative path>' for every file under out except the manifest itself, sorted by path ('/' separators).
  +    Returns (number of files, sha256 of the manifest)."""
  +    rows = []
  +    for dp, _, fns in os.walk(out):
  +        for fn in fns:
  +            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dp, fn), out).replace(os.sep, "/")
  +            if rel != "MANIFEST.sha256":
  +                rows.append((rel, sha256_file(os.path.join(dp, fn))))
  +    rows.sort()
  +    write_text("".join(f"{h}  {rel}\n" for rel, h in rows), os.path.join(out, "MANIFEST.sha256"))
  +    return len(rows), sha256_file(os.path.join(out, "MANIFEST.sha256"))

  +    def used_at(fn, p, T=1767225600):
  +        """N-FR2, N-FR6: fn() renames the fr route file p at the fixed clock T while p.used.<T> and p.used.<T>.1 of

  +# them after the fr cases, and they can be run alone (c3b_cases(directory)). Synthetic states and decisions only.
  +_C3B_A, _C3B_F, _C3B_H = "a" * 40, "f" * 40, "c" * 40           # the S2 commit, the fr commit, a c3b HEAD
  +_C3B_DATE = "2026-11-17"
  +
  +
  +def _c3b_state(**over):
  +    """The state after a passed FR, as c3b finds it: K3 fail_replan and the other C2 keys stay as recorded."""
  +    s = synthetic_state(commit=_C3B_A, G1={"Cl": True, "Ca": False}, K3="fail_replan",
  +                        campaigns={"c1": "done", "c2": "done", "c3": "not_run", "fr": "done"},
  +                        campaign_commit={"fr": _C3B_F},
  +                        commit_history=[{"from": _C3B_A, "to": _C3B_F, "note": "2026-11-14 results/objective2/s2/"
  +                                         "FR_OPERATIONS.md", "time": "2026-11-15T00:00:00Z",
  +                                         "via": "fr/CAMPAIGN_COMMIT", "campaign": "fr"}],
  +                        fr_step0={"attempts": 1, "outcome": "pass", "repeat": False, "fix_note": None},
  +                        FR={"outcome": "pass", "FR1": True, "FR2": True, "part": None, "cell": None, "kind": None})
  +    s.update(over)
  +    return s
  +
  +
  +def _c3b_git(head=_C3B_H, **over):
  +    """The mock git answers of an admissible c3b commit (MockBackend reads them from mock/config.json)."""
  +    fro = "results/objective2/s2/FR_OPERATIONS.md"
  +    cfg = {"git_head": head, "git_ancestors": [[_C3B_A, _C3B_F], [_C3B_A, head], [_C3B_F, head]],
  +           "git_tracked_paths": [C3B_NOTE, C3B_BLOCK4, fro],
  +           "git_changed": {f"{_C3B_F}..{head}": [C3B_NOTE, C3B_BLOCK4, "scripts/50_s2_campaign.py"],
  +                           f"{_C3B_A}..{head}": [C3B_NOTE, C3B_BLOCK4, fro, "scripts/50_s2_campaign.py"]}}
  +    cfg.update(over)
  +    return cfg
  +
  +
  +def _c3b_mini(base, tag, *, state=None, cfg=None, fr=None, nrule=True):
  +    """A mini node tree: mock boot and config, state.json, the fr tree of a done fr (CAMPAIGN_DONE, campaign.json with
  +    fr_outcome pass, a complete ledger; fr: overrides, a None value removing the file) and C1's applied n rule."""
  +    sysd = os.path.join(base, "c3b_" + tag); Rm = os.path.join(sysd, "data")
  +    for dd in ("data/work/s2/ledger", "data/jobs", "data/setup", "data/pseudo", "mock", "bin"):
  +        os.makedirs(os.path.join(sysd, dd), exist_ok=True)
  +    write_text("m-boot", os.path.join(sysd, "mock", "boot_id"))
  +    write_text(f"{time.time() - 60:.0f}", os.path.join(sysd, "mock", "btime.m-boot"))
  +    write_json(_c3b_git() if cfg is None else cfg, os.path.join(sysd, "mock", "config.json"))
  +    W = os.path.join(Rm, "work", "s2")
  +    write_json({"boot_id": "m-boot", "btime": time.time() - 60, "campaigns": []},
  +               os.path.join(W, "ledger", "boot.m-boot.json"))
  +    if state is not False:
  +        write_json(_c3b_state() if state is None else state, os.path.join(W, "state.json"))
  +    files = {"CAMPAIGN_DONE": "x\n", "campaign.json": {"status": "done", "fr_outcome": "pass"},
  +             "ledger.json": {"complete": True, "H_spent_h": 150.0, "problems": []}}
  +    files.update(fr or {})
  +    for f, v in files.items():
  +        if v is not None:
  +            (write_text if isinstance(v, str) else write_json)(v, os.path.join(W, "fr", f))
  +    if nrule:
  +        write_json({"schema": "s2-gate-applied-1", "gate": "nrule"}, os.path.join(W, "c1", "gates_applied",
  +                                                                                 "gate_nrule.json"))
  +    return sysd, Rm
  +
  +
  +def _c3b_checkout(sysd, *, block4="BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = True\n", note=f"C3b operations, {_C3B_DATE}.\n"):
  +    """A stand-in checkout holding the c3b note and E's block 4 (the runner reads both from the checkout)."""
  +    co = os.path.join(sysd, "checkout")
  +    if note is not None:
  +        write_text(note, os.path.join(co, C3B_NOTE))
  +    if block4 is not None:
  +        write_text(block4, os.path.join(co, C3B_BLOCK4))
  +    return co
  +
  +
  +def _c3b_runner(Rm, load=True, c="c3b"):
  +    rn = Runner(c, Rm, MockBackend(Rm)); rn.boot = "m-boot"
  +    if load:
  +        rn.state = rn.load_state()
  +    return rn
  +
  +
  +def _c3b_sites(h):
  +    """Synthetic site sets of a production host (2 / 3 / 8 first-shell and two far sites per sublattice)."""
  +    return {"B": {"first": [124, 136], "far": [76, 172]}, "A": {"first": [28, 92, 128], "far": [188, 164]},
  +            "X": {"first": [3, 49, 53, 90, 102, 125, 126, 138], "far": [175, 186]}}
  +
  +
  +def _c3b_stop(fn, word):
  +    try:
  +        fn()
  +    except Stop as e:
  +        assert word in str(e), (word, str(e))
  +        return str(e)
  +    raise AssertionError(f"no STOP ({word})")
  +
  +
  +def c3b_cases(base):
  +    """[(name, function)]: the self-test cases of campaign c3b."""
  +
  +    def z34():
  +        """N-C3B1: the c3b graph is the c3 graph but for its gates; the counts are the literals of S2B section 3."""
  +        st = _c3b_state()
  +        g3, gb = graph("c3", st, sites=_c3b_sites), graph("c3b", st, sites=_c3b_sites)
  +        assert gb["campaign"] == "c3b" and gb["phases"] == list(PHASES["c3"]) == list(PHASES["c3b"]), gb["phases"]
  +        assert gb["counts"] == C3B_COUNTS == expected_counts("c3b", st)[0] and assert_counts(gb, st)
  +        assert C3B_COUNTS == {"mace_host": 8, "mace_V": 8 * 19, "mace_dopant": 8 * 48, "sp": 8 * 68, "gate": 4}
  +        # the same jobs in the same order; only 'seq' differs (c3b has one more gate before them)
  +        rest3 = [{k: v for k, v in j.items() if k != "seq"} for j in g3["jobs"] if j["kind"] != "gate"]
  +        restb = [{k: v for k, v in j.items() if k != "seq"} for j in gb["jobs"] if j["kind"] != "gate"]
  +        assert rest3 == restb and len(restb) == 3 + 8 + 536 + 544 + 496, len(restb)
  +        assert [j["seq"] for j in gb["jobs"]] == list(range(len(gb["jobs"])))
  +        gates = [(j["id"], j["phase"], j["deps"], j["gate"], j.get("point")) for j in gb["jobs"] if j["kind"] == "gate"]
  +        assert gates == [("gate:s2b_projection@fr", "pre", [], "s2b_projection", "fr"),
  +                         ("gate:s2b_projection@c3b", "pre", ["gate:s2b_projection@fr"], "s2b_projection", "c3b"),
  +                         ("gate:c3b_complete", "gate", [], "c3b_complete", None),
  +                         ("gate:c3b_tier", "gate", ["gate:c3b_complete"], "c3b_tier", None)], gates
  +        assert [j["id"] for j in g3["jobs"] if j["kind"] == "gate"] == ["gate:projection@c3", "gate:c3_complete"]
  +        # cuts, multi_pose_cut and a multi pose are not read by the c3b graph (the precondition stops on the pose)
  +        odd = _c3b_state(cuts=[{"cut": 6}, {"cut": 7}, {"cut": 8}], multi_pose_cut={"Cs": True},
  +                         pose={"Cs": "multi", "Cl": "multi"})
  +        assert graph("c3b", odd, sites=_c3b_sites)["jobs"] == gb["jobs"]
  +        assert graph("c3", _c3b_state(pose={"Cs": "multi", "Cl": "default"}), sites=_c3b_sites)["counts"] != g3["counts"]
  +        # multi poses with no cut (under cuts 6 and 7 c3_multi is false whatever the pose; review finding 4): the c3
  +        # graph grows, the c3b graph does not
  +        multi = _c3b_state(pose={"Cs": "multi", "Cl": "multi"})
  +        assert c3_multi(multi, "Cs") and c3_multi(multi, "Cl") and not c3_multi(odd, "Cs")
  +        assert graph("c3b", multi, sites=_c3b_sites)["jobs"] == gb["jobs"]
  +        assert len(graph("c3", multi, sites=_c3b_sites)["jobs"]) > len(g3["jobs"])
  +        # the counts of c3b are returned before any legacy cut is read (review finding 12)
  +        assert expected_counts("c3b", _c3b_state(cuts="not a list"))[0] == C3B_COUNTS
  +        for bad in (_c3b_state(n=10), _c3b_state(n=None), _c3b_state(stage0={"production_n8": ["m06"]})):
  +            try:
  +                graph("c3b", bad, sites=_c3b_sites); raise AssertionError("a c3b graph without n = 8 hosts")
  +            except S2Error:
  +                pass
  +        tab = c3b_site_table(st, sites=_c3b_sites)
  +        assert sorted(tab) == sorted(st["stage0"]["production_n8"]) and tab["m06"]["A"] == {"first": [28, 92, 128],
  +                                                                                           "far": [188, 164]}
  +        assert "c3b" in CAMPAIGNS and GRAPHS["c3b"] is graph_c3b and S2B_CAMPAIGNS == ("fr", "c3b") and FR_ONLY == ("fr",)
  +        return (f"c3b graph: the {len(restb)} non-gate jobs of c3, gates s2b_projection@fr, @c3b (pre), c3b_complete, "
  +                f"c3b_tier (gate); counts 8 / 152 / 384 / 544 / 4 pinned; cuts and a multi pose not read; n = 8 needed")
  +
  +    def z35():
  +        """N-C3B4: a c3b start that FR does not allow is refused before any write (exit 2, no c3b tree)."""
  +        import contextlib
  +        rows = [("frrun", dict(state=_c3b_state(campaigns={"c1": "done", "c2": "done", "c3": "not_run",
  +                                                           "fr": "running"})), "campaigns.fr"),
  +                ("nodone", dict(fr={"CAMPAIGN_DONE": None}), "fr/CAMPAIGN_DONE"),
  +                ("frfail", dict(state=_c3b_state(FR={"outcome": "fail", "FR1": False, "FR2": None, "part": "FR-1",
  +                                                     "cell": "s2r_m30_VA188", "kind": "check"})), "not a pass"),
  +                ("fr2", dict(state=_c3b_state(FR={"outcome": "fail", "FR1": True, "FR2": False, "part": "FR-2",
  +                                                  "cell": None, "kind": None})), "not a pass"),
  +                ("frpart", dict(state=_c3b_state(FR={"outcome": "pass", "FR1": True, "FR2": True, "part": "FR-2",
  +                                                     "cell": None, "kind": None})), "not a pass"),
  +                ("nofr", dict(state={k: v for k, v in _c3b_state().items() if k != "FR"}), "not a pass"),
  +                ("frstop", dict(state=_c3b_state(fr_stop={"at": "s2r_m30_VA188", "kind": "check"})), "fr_stop"),
  +                ("s0", dict(state=_c3b_state(fr_step0={"attempts": 2, "outcome": "fail_final"})), "step-0"),
  +                ("cj", dict(fr={"campaign.json": {"status": "done", "fr_outcome": "fail (FR-2)"}}), "fr/campaign.json"),
  +                ("cjstop", dict(fr={"campaign.json": {"status": "stopped", "fr_outcome": "pass"}}), "fr/campaign.json"),
  +                ("nocj", dict(fr={"campaign.json": None}), "fr/campaign.json"),
  +                ("c4bkey", dict(state=_c3b_state(campaigns={"c1": "done", "c2": "done", "c3": "not_run", "fr": "done",
  +                                                            "c4b": "not_run"})), "c4b"),
  +                ("nostate", dict(state=False), "no state.json")]
  +        for tag, kw, word in rows:
  +            sysd, Rm = _c3b_mini(base, "ref_" + tag, **kw)
  +            rn = _c3b_runner(Rm, load=False)
  +            err = io.StringIO()
  +            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
  +                rc = rn.run()
  +            assert rc == 2 and word in err.getvalue() and "nothing started" in err.getvalue(), (tag, rc, err.getvalue())
  +            assert not os.path.lexists(rn.cdir) and not os.path.exists(rn.node.keep_alive), tag
  +        sysd, Rm = _c3b_mini(base, "ref_c4btree")
  +        os.makedirs(os.path.join(Rm, "work", "s2", "c4b"))
  +        rn = _c3b_runner(Rm, load=False)
  +        assert "c4b" in rn.c3b_refusal() and not os.path.lexists(rn.cdir)
  +        sysd, Rm = _c3b_mini(base, "ref_badjson")
  +        write_text("{not json", os.path.join(Rm, "work", "s2", "state.json"))
  +        assert "cannot be read" in _c3b_runner(Rm, load=False).c3b_refusal()
  +        sysd, Rm = _c3b_mini(base, "ref_ok")
  +        rn = _c3b_runner(Rm, load=False)
  +        assert rn.c3b_refusal() is None and rn.s2b_refusal() is None           # K3 fail_replan is not read
  +        assert _c3b_runner(Rm, load=False, c="fr").c3b_refusal() is None       # fr-only: no c3b refusal for fr
  +        return (f"{len(rows) + 2} refusals before any write (fr not done, FR not a pass, fr_stop, step-0, "
  +                f"fr/campaign.json, a c4b tree or entry, no or unreadable state): exit 2, no c3b tree; a passed FR "
  +                f"with K3 fail_replan is admitted")
  +
  +    def z36():
  +        """N-C3B4: the preconditions of c3b, each alone a STOP; no C2 key is read."""
  +        ok = _c3b_state(K2="fail", step0={"outcome": "fail_final"}, cuts=[{"cut": 8}], c4_run=False, a2_stopped=True)
  +        sysd, Rm = _c3b_mini(base, "pre_ok", state=ok)
  +        rn = _c3b_runner(Rm)
  +        assert rn.preconditions() is None and rn.a2_stopped() is False and rn.state == ok
  +        camp = dict(ok["campaigns"])
  +        rows = [({"campaigns": {**camp, "c2": "running"}}, "c2 is"), ({"campaigns": {**camp, "c3": "done"}}, "c3 is"),
  +                ({"campaigns": {**camp, "c1": "stopped"}}, "c1 is"), ({"campaigns": {**camp, "c4": "not_run"}}, "C4"),
  +                ({"campaigns": {k: v for k, v in camp.items() if k != "fr"}}, "fr is"),
  +                ({"n": 10}, "n = 8"), ({"n": None}, "n = 8"), ({"G1": {"Cl": True, "Ca": True}}, "G1"),
  +                ({"G1": {"Cl": False, "Ca": False}}, "G1"), ({"G1": {}}, "G1"),
  +                ({"pose": {"Cs": "multi", "Cl": "default"}}, "poses"), ({"pose": {"Cs": "default"}}, "poses"),
  +                ({"stage0": {"production_n8": ["m06"] * 7}}, "eight hosts"), ({"stage0": {}}, "eight hosts")]
  +        for over, word in rows:
  +            r_ = _c3b_runner(Rm); r_.state.update(over)
  +            _c3b_stop(r_.preconditions, word)
  +        sysd2, Rm2 = _c3b_mini(base, "pre_nonrule", state=ok, nrule=False)
  +        _c3b_stop(_c3b_runner(Rm2).preconditions, "n rule")
  +        MOCKED.append("49_s2_gates.py")
  +        try:
  +            _c3b_stop(_c3b_runner(Rm).preconditions, "stub")
  +        finally:
  +            MOCKED.remove("49_s2_gates.py")
  +        g49.C4B_PLANNED = True
  +        try:
  +            _c3b_stop(_c3b_runner(Rm).preconditions, "C4B_PLANNED")
  +        finally:
  +            g49.C4B_PLANNED = False
  +        assert g49.C4B_PLANNED is False and g49.C4B_ORIGIN == "decision (S2B amendment 2026-11-16a)"
  +        return (f"preconditions: a state with K3 fail_replan, K2 fail, a final step-0 failure, cut 8 and a2_stopped "
  +                f"passes (no C2 key read; a2_stopped False); {len(rows) + 3} single defects are STOPs (campaign "
  +                f"states, n, the n rule, G1, poses, the host list, the scripts/49 stub, a planned C4b)")
  +
  +    def z37():
  +        """N-C3B3: the dated route of c3b."""
  +        line = f"{_C3B_H} {_C3B_DATE} {C3B_NOTE}\n"
  +
  +        def start(tag, *, cfg=None, state=None, route=line, **co):
  +            sysd, Rm = _c3b_mini(base, "route_" + tag, cfg=cfg, state=state)
  +            rn = _c3b_runner(Rm)
  +            rn.node.checkout = _c3b_checkout(sysd, **co)
  +            if route is not None:
  +                write_text(route, os.path.join(rn.cdir, "CAMPAIGN_COMMIT"))
  +            return rn
  +        _c3b_stop(start("none", route=None).check_commit, "no c3b/CAMPAIGN_COMMIT")
  +        rn = start("ok")
  +        before = copy.deepcopy(rn.state)
  +        rn.check_commit()
  +        s = read_json(rn.node.state)
  +        assert s["campaign_commit"] == {"fr": _C3B_F, "c3b": _C3B_H} and s["commit"] == _C3B_A
  +        assert s["commit_history"][:-1] == before["commit_history"] and len(s["commit_history"]) == 2
  +        h = s["commit_history"][-1]
  +        assert (h["from"], h["to"], h["via"], h["campaign"], h["note"]) == \
  +            (_C3B_F, _C3B_H, "c3b/CAMPAIGN_COMMIT", "c3b", f"{_C3B_DATE} {C3B_NOTE}"), h
  +        assert {k: v for k, v in s.items() if k not in ("campaign_commit", "commit_history")} == \
  +            {k: v for k, v in before.items() if k not in ("campaign_commit", "commit_history")}
  +        left = os.listdir(rn.cdir)
  +        assert "CAMPAIGN_COMMIT" not in left and any(x.startswith("CAMPAIGN_COMMIT.used.") for x in left), left
  +        # later starts: the same HEAD passes, also with fr's route file names lying about (not read); a leftover
  +        # route file of the recorded commit is renamed; another HEAD is a STOP (no fix route)
  +        r2 = _c3b_runner(os.path.dirname(rn.cdir).rsplit(os.sep + "work", 1)[0])
  +        write_text("x 2026-11-18 note\n", os.path.join(r2.cdir, "STEP0_FIX"))
  +        write_text("2026-11-18 none\n", os.path.join(r2.cdir, "STEP0_NO_ERROR"))
  +        write_text(line, os.path.join(r2.cdir, "CAMPAIGN_COMMIT"))
  +        r2.check_commit()
  +        assert read_json(r2.node.state) == s and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(r2.cdir, "CAMPAIGN_COMMIT"))
  +        assert os.path.exists(os.path.join(r2.cdir, "STEP0_FIX")) and os.path.exists(os.path.join(r2.cdir, "STEP0_NO_ERROR"))
  +        write_text(f"{'d' * 40} {_C3B_DATE} {C3B_NOTE}\n", os.path.join(r2.cdir, "CAMPAIGN_COMMIT"))
  +        _c3b_stop(r2.check_commit, "used once")
  +        os.remove(os.path.join(r2.cdir, "CAMPAIGN_COMMIT"))
  +        write_json(_c3b_git(head="d" * 40), os.path.join(os.path.dirname(r2.node.root), "mock", "config.json"))
  +        _c3b_stop(r2.check_commit, "no fix route")
  +        assert read_json(r2.node.state) == s
  +        # refusals of the route, each alone; nothing is recorded and the file stays
  +        fro = "results/objective2/s2/FR_OPERATIONS.md"
  +        chg = _c3b_git()["git_changed"]
  +        rows = [("frnote", dict(route=f"{_C3B_H} {_C3B_DATE} {fro}\n"), "the note of the c3b route"),
  +                ("headfr", dict(cfg=_c3b_git(head=_C3B_F), route=f"{_C3B_F} {_C3B_DATE} {C3B_NOTE}\n"), "strict descendant"),
  +                ("stub", dict(block4="X = 1\nBLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = False\n"), "is the stub"),
  +                ("stubi", dict(block4="    BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = False  # stub\n"), "is the stub"),
  +                ("nob4", dict(cfg=_c3b_git(git_tracked_paths=[C3B_NOTE, fro])), "is not tracked"),
  +                ("b4gone", dict(block4=None), "cannot be read"),
  +                ("b4none", dict(block4="X = 1\n"), "holds no line"),
  +                ("b4nosp", dict(block4="BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED=False\n"), "is the stub"),
  +                ("b4ann", dict(block4="BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED: bool = True\n"), "otherwise than by the one line"),
  +                ("b4two", dict(block4="BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = True\nBLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = True\n"), "2 assignments"),
  +                ("b4both", dict(block4="BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = True\nBLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = False\n"), "2 assignments"),
  +                ("b4ind", dict(block4="if True:\n    BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = True\n"), "otherwise than by the one line"),
  +                ("ndraft", dict(note=f"DRAFT. C3b operations, {_C3B_DATE}.\n"), "still holds 'DRAFT'"),
  +                ("ntoken", dict(note=f"C3b operations, {_C3B_DATE} (DATE-OF-COMMIT).\n"), "still holds 'DATE-OF-COMMIT'"),
  +                ("nopen", dict(note=f"C3b operations, {_C3B_DATE}. **[open]** one item.\n"), "still holds '[open]'"),
  +                ("unchanged", dict(cfg=_c3b_git(git_changed={**chg, f"{_C3B_F}..{_C3B_H}": ["scripts/50_s2_campaign.py"]})),
  +                 "is not changed between"),
  +                ("nodate", dict(note="C3b operations, undated.\n"), "does not contain its date"),
  +                ("notanc", dict(cfg=_c3b_git(git_ancestors=[[_C3B_A, _C3B_F], [_C3B_A, _C3B_H]])), "is not an ancestor"),
  +                ("nofrcc", dict(state=_c3b_state(campaign_commit={})), "no fr campaign commit"),
  +                ("otherhead", dict(route=f"{'d' * 40} {_C3B_DATE} {C3B_NOTE}\n"), "is not the checkout HEAD"),
  +                ("nodes", dict(cfg=_c3b_git(git_changed={**chg, f"{_C3B_A}..{_C3B_H}": ["ehpc/node/chain.sh"]})),
  +                 "differ from the recorded S2 commit")]
  +        for tag, kw, word in rows:
  +            r_ = start(tag, **kw)
  +            s0 = read_json(r_.node.state)
  +            _c3b_stop(r_.check_commit, word)
  +            assert read_json(r_.node.state) == s0 and os.path.exists(os.path.join(r_.cdir, "CAMPAIGN_COMMIT")), tag
  +        ok2 = start("okb4", block4="# BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = False at the FR commit\nBLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = True\n")
  +        ok2.check_commit()                                                 # a comment naming the stub is no stub

  +        return (f"route: accepted once (campaign_commit.c3b, history from the fr commit, state.commit and "
  +                f"campaign_commit.fr unchanged, file renamed); the same HEAD later, fr's route files unread; another "
  +                f"HEAD: no fix route; {len(rows)} refusals (FR_OPERATIONS.md as note, HEAD = the fr commit, a block 4 "
  +                f"that is the stub, untracked, or without the one line 'BLOCK4_IMPLEMENTED = True', a note unchanged, "

  +    def z38():
  +        """N-C3B2: the protected state of a c3b runner; the fr digest is that of 0a3e8f0."""
